degree.text: Degree Awarded Master’s Degree of Economics

description.text: Why study in BUAA 1．China’s first university of aeronautics and astronautics engineering and academic research. 2．One of the most famous universities in China, equipped with advancedlaboratories and teaching apparatus. 3．Campus is known for its beautiful environment, convenient transportation and various facilities. 4．Situated in the capital in the center of Zhongguancun Science Park, next to China’s National Olympic Center. 5．Located in the west of Beijing, close to the thriving boutiques and cafes of Wudaokou. 6．Equipped with high quality teaching team and professional laboratories. Program Introduction Most lecturers of the core & distinctive courses are fluent English-speaking lecturers recruited worldwide. All lecturers have practical experience in teaching and years of experience working in the industry. In addition, renowned scholars and practitioners will be invited to give lessons or lectures. Teaching Objective To nurture qualified and skilled talents who will have a good grasp of knowledge in international trade, management, and finance as well as the experience in operating and handling real-life projects, especially those pertaining to Chinese economy, society, and who understand the Chinese culture values, so as to meet the demands of the fast changing world economy. Main Courses For reference: Microeconomics,Corporate Finance,Marketing Management, Accounting, International Finance, Decision Analysis, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Decision Modeling and Analysis with MS Excel, Macroeconomics, Operational Research, Project Management, Investment, Econometrics, International Trade, Human Resource Management, Statistics, Retail Management, Modern Heuristic Optimization Theory and Algorithms, Scientific Thesis Writing. Fee Structure Tuition fee: 35000RMB/year Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, visits to companies, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, and career consultation. Duration 3 years Degree Awarded Master’s Degree of Economics Future Career The university will help get employ chances in good companies and organizations. Teaching Facilities The school has 7 national level key laboratories, 3 national level engineering research centers, 42 provincial and ministerial level key laboratories. Also has 4 Innovative Research Groups of National Natural Science Foundation of China, 11 Innovation Teams of Ministry of Education, 6 Defense-Related Science and Technology Innovation Teams. Teacher Highlight 3759 faculties and staffs are on the job, including 2102 full-time teachers, 1668 professors and associate professors, 73.0% of teachers have doctorate degree. There are 17 academicians of Chinese Academy of Sciences and Chinese Academy of Engineering, 16 hired experts of “Thousands of People Plan” from the Organization Department of the of the CPC Central Committee, 23 chief scientists of “973” plan, 41 professors of “Changjiang Scholars Program”, 31 obtainers of “National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars”, high-level talented persons represented by three national level teaching masters, etc..

duration.text: The International Trade at Beihang University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7. Financial support statement A certificate from the financial guarantor of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.In general the applicant should have a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree or have the equivalent educational background of (a B.S.) degree. 3.The applicant should be forty years of age or under. 4.The applicant must have a good command of English and have the ability to take courses in English or Chinese.
